basic_info.description: Stunning single family home perched at the top of Laurel Hill with sweeping views to the north of the Golden Gate and to the south of Lone Mountain, Sutro Tower & beyond. The oversized lot features frontage on Lupine and Wood Street at the back. The living & dining rooms display expansive floor to ceiling windows. The skylit sunny eat-in kitchen features newly refaced and freshly painted cabinets, new quartz counters & a huge double doored pantry. The rear of the home overlooks the south garden & both bedrooms upstairs step out to a wide sunny deck. The large primary suite boasts multiple closets & a newly refreshed bath painted jade green with a glowing glass tiled floor lit by a huge skylight by day & subtle alabaster sconces by night. On the bottom level you will find a spacious family room with built ins, plus a wet bar & fridge in a nook that could be concealed behind folding doors if desired. It leads to a generous patio that flows in turn to the huge, sheltered & sunny terraced rear garden & citrus grove. Adjacent to the family room is the 3rd bedroom with its own refreshed en-suite bath. Finally, the enormous double garage defies all SF expectations: large enough for two cars, with a tremendous amount of storage and finished flooring, plus an extra wide driveway!
